items.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000
items.q: Lionel Hampton was there with his band, it was unbelievable.

ctx.x: Right. Carnegie Hall. He always played that, wherever he played. It never failed. He had to play that. People asked for it, and he always had to close his show with “Sing Sing Sing.” Can you imagine playing that 5, 6, 7, 8 times a day and night? He played it at the Paramount Theater. And one time, I’ll never forget, Monk, he was playing at the Paramount Theater in the Pennsylvania Hotel. He was doing a radio broadcast called the Camel Caravan, he was recording, I don’t know when he had time. Gene Krupa told me he…
You couldn’t believe how tall he was?
